resolution: Fixed both reports (commit 8bd2decbf). (1) Flat stickers: a zero-thickness skin-box row now draws a 12-vert two-sided sticker quad (framework/world_loader/geometry.zig buildStickerQuad, one per thin axis, same winding/UV convention as the cube) instead of the 36-vert cube — 4 triangles per stamp instead of 12, exact size, no outset; pieceSkins sends thickness exactly 0. NEEDS A FRAMEWORK REBUILD to take effect (until then the zero dim renders as the old hair-thin box — graceful). (2) Import honesty: the pixel-texture probe downsamples to 128 on the longest side and stores JSON RLE, so a well-packed original (indexed PNG of flat art) can beat it on BOTH resolution and bytes — the dialog no longer recommends the pixel form in that case, and the card now says 'DOWNSAMPLED from WxH' and 'LARGER than the original' loudly. Also answered the tool question: Build menu > Place Sticker, or just press K in a world doc.
